reason: My whole client life runs through Outlook on Microsoft 365, and it says right there that Outlook email isn't supported yet, so the email-to-task part that would have saved me last month just doesn't work for me. would_change_my_mind: Full Outlook / Microsoft 365 email and calendar support, plus a way to bring my clients and notes over from Notion.
